serverStatus.title: Server status
serverStatus.wakingHint: The server sleeps after 15 minutes without use. The first request can take about a minute; there is no need to reload the page.
serverStatus.upHint: The API and the database are responding.
serverStatus.degradedHint: The API responds, but it cannot reach the database.
serverStatus.unreachableHint: The API could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
